description: This PHP script interacts with the TestLink API via XML-RPC to create a test suite within a given project. It constructs arguments with API keys and project details, makes an API call to create the test suite, and handles the response by setting environment variables or throwing exceptions on failure.

classes.name: IXR_Client
classes.description: A client class used to make XML-RPC calls to the server, facilitating communication with the TestLink API.

methods.name: runTest
methods.description: A function that executes the specified API method with given arguments through the XML-RPC client, and returns the response.
